Hij is de oprichter en leider van het zogenaamde 'Koninkrijk Duitsland' (KRD), een groepering die de Duitse staatsorde niet erkent en een eigen monarchie wil vestigen.

articles.title: Fearing AI disruption, white-collar workers are quitting their jobs
articles.snippet: While there’s no evidence linking AI to mass layoffs, the tech has already ‘changed worker psychology’ When artificial intelligence researcher Mrinank Sharma quit his job at Anthropic earlier this year, the news rippled across the internet. In his resignation letter, posted on X and viewed 15.3m times, Sharma warned of a world “in peril” from the technology he had helped build. “It is clear to me the time has come to move on,” he wrote. articles.snippet: RMT union calls eight 24-hour strikes on London Underground in opposition to plans for four-day week Tube train drivers in the RMT union have called eight 24-hour strikes running over 16 days – including six in the lead-up to Christmas – that threaten to bring transport chaos to the capital. articles.title: US job growth exceeds expectations in October despite economic uncertainty
articles.snippet: ‘Low-hire, low-fire’ labor market shows sluggish growth but few layoffs, with an interest rate hike expected in December The US added 165,000 jobs to the economy in October, a sign of resilience in the labor market amid ongoing war in the Middle East and inflation, according to new data released on Friday. Economists had said the labor market has been stuck in a “low-hire, low-fire” state, in which job growth is sluggish but layoffs also remain low, but October’s data surpassed economist expectations. The unemployment rate went down slightly to 4.1%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported. Continue reading...

articles.title: Sire, geef me 10 dagen: koning verwacht 16 november update van De Wever, maar wat kan nu dat vorige week niet kon?
articles.snippet: Koning Filip verwacht dat premier Bart De Wever (N-VA) binnen 10 dagen een update klaar heeft over zijn begrotingsonderhandelingen. articles.snippet: In Frankrijk zijn vanochtend 2 doden gevallen bij een busongeval. De slachtoffers zijn 7 en 18 jaar oud. Het ongeval vond plaats in de Franse gemeente Lent, in de buurt van Lyon.
